title: Stephen F NDE 3801
content: I left my body completely. I rose above it to the point where my thorax was just above my head. I do not know where my legs and feet were. I was able to look down through my head and into the inside of my body. I saw nothing there but blood dripping from the inside of my empty rib cage. I could see the inside of the soles of my feet. There was a bright light above and behind me. I went back into my body and the light went away.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Rupture of aneurysm in abdominal aorta 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was bleeding to death from the ruptured aneurysm.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Light
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Throughout it.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Altered space.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was above and behind me throughout the experience.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion

elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I see it clearly all the time.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real When the incident happened, I quickly realized that it was time to fight to get back to life. My ability to concentrate and focus saved me. I had been a translator for twenty years. I know how to concentrate.
